title: POST /api/projects/:id/share/revoke — revoke and regenerate share token
description: Revoke the current share token (making the old URL invalid) and generate a new one. Sets is_public = false as well.
acceptanceCriteria: POST requires auth and project ownership
Generates a new UUID share_token (old one is no longer valid)

steps.details: getOwnedProject. Generate new UUID token. Update project: share_token = newToken, is_public = false. Return 200.
Enable sharing, get share URL, then revoke. Try the old share URL — expect 404. Enable sharing again — get a different URL.
